answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose committed secret authorizes rate-limited messages. Semaphore proofs bind each message to an epoch and nullifier; duplicate use yields distinct Shamir shares that can be interpolated to recover the agent’s private key. Anyone can verify the evidence and trigger immediate collateral slashing. Across dune, island, and mesa deployments, this makes identities costly to multiply and messaging abuse economically punishable.
